findings.title: New helpers use Optional instead of X | None
findings.problem: code-quality.md says avoid typing.Optional[X] in new code and prefer X | None; the newly added _timed_call, _pooled_call, run_builds, custom_build_jobs, collect_custom_executors signatures use Optional[...].
findings.impact: Documented code-quality standard not met by newly added code; blocks the workflow per the standards review.
findings.recommendation: Use X | None in the newly added functions/signatures (e.g. tuple[Any, BaseException | None]) and drop Optional from the new code.

findings.title: Concurrent-safety tests do not exercise real shared state
findings.problem: Required AC5 is partial. test_concurrent_prepare_calls_on_one_conversation_both_succeed patches AgentWorkspaceService, SkillService, SkillWorkspaceSeeder and AgentWorkspaceRepository and asserts only results == [[], []], which holds for any implementation; its docstring claims on-conflict-do-nothing atomicity that the test never runs. The request-files test calls build_unique_file_objects directly in the pool rather than through a real child build, and the isolation test covers only toolkits, mcp_servers and context.
findings.impact: Builtin children now call prepare_skill_workspace concurrently for one conversation; a race (duplicate workspace, unique violation) would be silently skipped by the non-fatal builtin path and no test would fail. Whether the repository insert is atomic is unconfirmed by tests.
findings.recommendation: Add a test running the real repository/seeder (or repository-level insert) from two threads on one conversation_id asserting one workspace and no error; make the request-files test go through a real child build and assert each child sees the files; extend the isolation test to the parent request.
